Swatch x Omega MoonSwatch Silver Snowflake, reference SSX01B701: £350 in the UK, per Time+Tide Watches on 25 November 2026.

Each watch has its own snowflake laser-engraved on the moon dial. Launch is 27 November 2026 at selected Swatch stores worldwide.

The catch: after launch it sells only while snow falls in Switzerland, through 20 March 2027. Prices can differ by market.

Would you wait for snow to buy it?
